newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent cements gains ahead of July expiry.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent cements gains ahead of July expiry.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures held onto gains after NYMEX opened on Friday, buoyed by short covering ahead of the expiry of the July Brent contract, dealers said.

By 1445 gmt July Brent was up 36 cents at $17.80 a barrel. July gas oil was $1.75 higher at $164.25 a tonne while in New York July crude was 43 cents better at $19.12 after ACCESS trade pushed the front-month higher.
With the NYMEX July crude options contract expiring today there was additional buying support in the market, said brokers.
"The expiry on the options is a big factor and they want to keep things above $19.00. You can't buck that," said a dealer.
